removed_articles.title: Consumer access to query Unity Gateway services is generally available
removed_articles.summary:
Users with the consumer access entitlement no longer need an account admin to enable the "Consumer access to Unity Gateway" preview to query the model services and model provider services shared with them, or to use Unity Gateway coding agent features. See Consumer access capabilities.

This change can increase model traffic from consumer access users, including traffic to external providers. To control this traffic, account admins can set budgets and rate limits, or disable direct model access, for consumer access users. See Manage budgets for Unity Gateway, Apply rate limits to model and MCP services, and Manage entitlements.

removed_articles.title: Unity Gateway Skills API and developer tools are available in Beta
removed_articles.summary:
The Unity Gateway Skills REST API is now available in Beta, with create, read, update, list, delete, and finalize support across Databricks developer tools:

  • Databricks CLI
  • Python SDK
  • Go SDK
  • Go Modular SDK
  • Java SDK
  • JavaScript SDK

See the Skills API and SDK reference.
